svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 233 mm of 18 x 12 mm clear acrylic tube; square both ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Root end: solvent-weld a 12 mm acrylic plug 3 mm deep.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a 3 mm hole in the underside 8 mm from the root end for the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: laser's wires; seal it with clear silicone after threading them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the root end sits 37 mm in front of the hull's front face,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 7 mm clear of the dome. Solvent-weld the tube along the fin's top

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edge, on the camera axis 62 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The front end goes 10 mm into the diode housing (bond with epoxy).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Keep the tube clean and unscratched: the camera looks through it.
